title: MKA: Evaluating Multimodal Knowledge Agents on end-to-end professional tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.25228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce the Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark, which measures how well autonomous agents perform end-to-end professional knowledge work that depends on visual understanding. Each task requires an agent to extract and combine information from multiple visually dense files, such as CAD blueprints, electronics schematics, radiographs, complex charts and geospatial maps, and to produce a standalone deliverable in .xlsx, .pptx, .pdf, .docx, .html or .png format. Existing benchmarks leave this capability largely untested: removing image-viewing tools leaves Gemini 4 Carbon's score on GDPval unchanged, and single-format evaluations such as GDP.pdf and GDP.xlsx do not require reasoning across files or modalities. MKA contains 200 tasks across 10 economic sectors. Deliverables are graded against expert-weighted rubrics by a sandboxed agentic autorater that agrees with human domain experts on 96.2% of criterion judgments in our exper

translated_title: MKA：在端到端专业任务上评估多模态知识智能体
translated_abstract: 我们提出了多模态知识智能体（MKA）基准，用于衡量自主智能体在依赖视觉理解的端到端专业知识工作中的表现。每个任务要求智能体从多个视觉密集型文件（如CAD蓝图、电子原理图、放射影像、复杂图表和地理空间地图）中提取并整合信息，并生成独立的交付成果，格式包括.xlsx、.pptx、.pdf、.docx、.html或.png。现有基准基本未测试这一能力：移除图像查看工具并不会改变Gemini 4 Carbon在GDPval上的得分，而诸如GDP.pdf和GDP.xlsx这类单一格式评估也不需要跨文件或跨模态的推理。MKA包含涵盖10个经济领域的200个任务。交付成果由沙盒化的智能体自动评分器根据专家加权的评分标准进行评分，该评分器在实验中与人类领域专家在96.2%的评判标准判断上保持一致。
tldr: MKA基准通过200个要求智能体从CAD蓝图、原理图、影像图等多模态视觉密集文件中提取整合信息并生成专业格式交付成果的任务，填补了现有基准无法评估端到端专业多模态知识工作能力的空白。
en_tdlr: The MKA benchmark fills a gap in evaluating autonomous agents on end-to-end professional knowledge work, using 200 tasks that require extracting and synthesizing information from visually dense multimodal files into standalone deliverables, with a sandboxed agentic autorater agreeing with human experts on 96.2% of criterion judgments.
